what: A test build was started on the VM while the measuring script ran: the rows of that run (no-op run 20.6 ms against 12.6) were the compile's, not the binary's.
cost: one measurement thrown away and run again
cause: one VM for building and measuring, and nothing that refuses to measure while a build runs
workaround: waited for `pgrep cargo` to be empty before each measurement
state: open: the measuring script could refuse when the machine is busy
class: vacuous success (A39), neighbour: a measurement of another program than the one named; ran.py's proof (text only the measured program prints) is the guard
